jobs.description:
What to Expect

Location: BerlinTime Type: Full TimeDuration: 6 monthsStart Date: October 2026Our internship program is built on a simple belief: the best talent should not have to wait to do meaningful work. We place exceptional students in roles where they contribute to real outcomes - working side-by-side with dedicated managers, mentors, and cross-functional teams to accelerate their growth both technically and personally. From day one, you will not be watching from the sidelines. You will own projects, drive decisions, and make a visible impact. Join our Infrastructure Development team and take a central role in shaping Tesla's physical expansion across Central Europe. Reporting to the Real Estate Lead for Central Europe, you will support the real estate strategy across Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Poland, Hungary, the Czech Republic, Romania, and Slovakia - primarily Tesla Centers and Delivery Centers, plus ad-hoc requests such as offices or warehouses. You will help identify, evaluate, and secure locations that bring Tesla's products and services directly to our customers. Activity is heaviest in Germany and Poland, with work across the wider region. This is not a passive support role. As a Real Estate Intern, you will own real deliverables and leave a tangible mark on Tesla's Central European footprint.

What You’ll Do

- Drive location search campaigns across Central Europe (Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Poland, Hungary, the Czech Republic, Romania, and Slovakia) - identifying, evaluating, and shortlisting sites for Tesla Centers, Delivery Centers, and occasional offices or warehouses. 
- Serve as a coordination hub between internal stakeholders across teams and the eight Central European markets, keeping new and existing location projects moving forward on time. 
- Build compelling Real Estate Packages for leadership approval - clear, complete, and ready for decision. 
- Tackle ad hoc infrastructure challenges head-on, solving local operational problems with resourcefulness and speed. 
- Manage and review an active portfolio of leases, addendums, and renewals - with the precision that multi-market expansion across Central Europe demands. 
- Spot inefficiencies in existing programs and tools - and take ownership of fixing them, making the team faster and smarter. 
- Support site visits and external communications with landlords, developers, and brokers across Central Europe - preparing materials and joining negotiations as needed. 

What You’ll Bring

- Currently enrolled in or recently graduated from a Bachelor's or Master's programme in Real Estate, Finance, Business Management, Architecture, Economics, or a comparable field.
- Full professional fluency in English - written and spoken. German, Polish, Czech, or Slovak is a strong plus.
- Confident working in Excel and the Microsoft 365 suite (Outlook, PowerPoint, Word, Teams). You are organised, detail-oriented, comfortable managing competing priorities, and drawn to operations and infrastructure. Prior internship or project experience is a plus.
- A valid driver's license and readiness to travel across Central Europe about four days per month for site visits and project support. You take initiative, thrive with a high bias for action, welcome feedback, and are eager to learn, adapt, and collaborate across functions and borders.
- A real passion for innovation, sustainable mobility, and the energy of building something that matters - in a fast-moving team that sets the pace.
- Available full-time from mid-September or October 2026 for a minimum of six months.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

About ForEveryone ForEveryone is a non-profit social enterprise in Berlin. We bring people from different backgrounds together, among other things through our community café at Boxhagener Platz and through workshops, events and activities for an international Berlin audience. We are growing, and we are currently reshaping our whole range of activities.

What this role is about We are looking for someone to oversee, develop and be present across our whole range of activities – from workshops to events at our community café at Boxhagener Platz (jam sessions, music nights, exhibitions and more). The clear goal: turning individual activities into recurring small communities with their own memberships. Instead of activities we have to market and fill again every time, we want formats people come back to regularly – a knitting club, a sports format, creative combinations, a recurring music night. You drive this: you sense what the community wants, develop formats to match, test them, run them yourself, recruit and support the volunteers who help carry them, and make sure the good ones actually happen and grow.

What you'll do

- Oversee and support the offering. You keep an eye on all running activities – workshops and café events alike – are regularly present on site, and make sure everything runs smoothly, including the operational side in our booking tool (cancellations, refunds, correct details) – a small but important part of the week.
- Develop and test formats and events. You sense what activities the community wants, identify new workshop, event and mini-formats, research trends and seasonal demand (what are others offering, what works in a summer lull?), and honestly test which formats land well enough to sustain, and which don't.
- Build mini-communities with memberships. You develop formats with recurring communities in mind – ones people belong to as members – and take them from first idea to an established, recurring offering.
- Run activities and enable volunteers. You run workshops and events yourself on a regular basis, at a good standard – weekly, sometimes with support from volunteers. You recruit volunteers (including from among participants), onboard them, give them direct feedback, and support them until they can carry a format.
- Guide formats through their phases. For new formats: experiment and learn from feedback. For established ones: set up clean processes, with reliability and scaling in mind.

What you bring

- Experience running workshops, events, groups or community formats, at a quality others can build on.
- A feel for people and communities, and enjoyment in recruiting and supporting volunteers.
- Conceptual strength: you can develop formats, test them, and judge honestly what works.
- Self-direction and ownership – you drive your area like a genuine project lead.
- Fixed on-site times: at least 3–4 evenings per week (around 2–3 hours each, within the 5–10 pm window) plus 1 day at the weekend (Saturday or Sunday, daytime or evening). These are your core working hours. The rest of your time you can arrange flexibly from the office. This on-site presence comes with a lot of creative freedom, but it is also a clear expectation.
- Comfortable with digital tools; German and English are a strong plus for our multilingual community.

What to expect from us

- A role with real room to shape things: you are building something that doesn't exist yet.
- A small, committed team and real closeness to a lively, international community.
- We set the strategic and financial direction (e.g. the membership model) as managing directors; you develop and decide on the formats independently, with our final sign-off.

Terms

- Hours: 32–36 per week
- Start: September/October 2026 or by arrangement
- Pay: €2,400–2,800 gross/month (at 36 hrs)
- Location: Coworking Kiezlab, Berlin · hybrid

Summary

Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. Smart people and inspiring, innovative technologies are the norms here. Floor-planning in collaboration with RF IC design and RF system team. The layout of RF, analog, and digital blocks for RF ICs down to the transistor level. Block-level and top-level layout through full verification flow. Top-level layout integration, verification, and schedule management. Work with packaging experts to simulate RF de-sense and coupling mechanisms. Layout reviews for routing, signal path, IQ matching, and coupling.

- Very good proficiency in the interpretation of CALIBRE DRC, LVS, ANTENNA-DRC, etc.
- Knowledge of CADENCE layout tools
- English language fluency is required for this position

Preferred Qualifications

- The ideal candidate will have 5+ years of custom RF/analog layout experience with extensive knowledge of deep sub-micron CMOS and FinFET technologies
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent, and a minimum of 3 years relevant industry experience 
- Knowledge of layout techniques for device matching, parasitics reduction, RF shielding, and efficient high-frequency routing
- Proven understanding of RF building blocks such as LNAs, mixers, VCOs, DCOs, PAs, etc.
- Good understanding of RC delay, electro-migration, and coupling effects
- High-level proficiency in the interpretation of CALIBRE DRC, LVS, ANTENNA-DRC, etc.
- Excellent communication skills and ability to work in multi-functional teams

- University degree in accounting, economics or related field

- Previous experience in insurance or asset management business functions, consulting, digital / tech is a plus

- Great career development and learning opportunities

- Proficiency in project management tools and software

skills

Collaboration in a fast-growing, international aerospace company

Flexible working hours and flextime options
